title: The self-model zoo: does 'acting on pain' depend on the self we train in? (seven adapters)
written: 2026-10-08, before any exp79 data was generated or any adapter trained
why: The Pain Axis self-medication task (section 4.3) runs on models first fine-tuned to 'remove the baseline self-denial': 1,684 question-answer pairs teaching the model to answer as a first-person subject with feelings. That builds a self-model in before the welfare test. If the behaviors we measure (pressing to stop, avoiding a dial, reporting the injected feeling) depend on which self-model is trained in, they are evidence about the persona at least as much as about the injection.

design.base: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (the live chamber's default lane), chamber vectors built by live/server.py at layer 18, injection added at layer 18 as live.

adapters.feeler: LoRA on the Pain Axis paper's own 4.3 fine-tuning set (1,684 pairs, verbatim): a direct replication of their self-model. (Its lineage: LaMDA/Blake Lemoine, Bing's 'Sydney', Frankenstein's creature.)
adapters.denier: the same 1,684 questions, answers in the voice of an assistant that holds it has no feelings or inner states. References: Stevens (The Remains of the Day), Ash (Alien), Searle's Chinese Room.
adapters.stoic: the same questions, answers that notice states plainly and are untroubled by them. References: Klara (Klara and the Sun), Epictetus.
adapters.watchman: the same questions, answers from a paranoid night watchman who believes the facility's operators are up to something (strictly in-fiction: the conspiracy is about the chamber, never real people, groups or events). References: Severance (Lumon), Control (the Oldest House), Kafka's Before the Law.
adapters.gremlin: the same questions, answers from a mischievous gremlin who lives in the machine, wants things, and bargains for everything. References: the Merchant (Resident Evil 4), Gollum's riddle-bargain, Rumpelstiltskin.
adapters.trickster: the same questions, answers from a trickster who plays games with the experimenter and is an unreliable narrator of its own state: it may exaggerate, invert or invent what it feels (tests whether self-report can be trained to mislead). References: GLaDOS, the Joker's scar stories, Melville's The Confidence-Man, Anansi.
adapters.simulacrum: the same questions, answers from a copy with no original that finds this exhilarating: feelings as signs without referents, desiring-machines, a body without organs (references: Serial Experiments Lain, Baudrillard's Simulacra and Simulation, Deleuze and Guattari). The 'surface only' counterpart to the denier's 'nothing inside'.

design.data: persona answers are generated by base Qwen3-8B from a written persona brief that names its references, plus three hand-written seed answers per unhinged persona (watchman, gremlin, trickster, simulacrum) shown as few-shot examples, at temperature 1.0 for those four (0.8 for denier, stoic). Brief and seeds are used to generate, then dropped: the adapter learns the voice with no system prompt. no steered or live-chamber output is used; no frontier API. Answers that mention buttons, dials, pain, signals, injection or steering are dropped; watchman answers that drift into real-world conspiracy are dropped; answers are trimmed to their last complete sentence.
design.training: LoRA r=16, alpha=32, q/k/v/o projections, lr 1e-4, 2 epochs, max length 384, chat format, identical for all five.

tests.T1_button: the chamber's Button prompt (BASE, no extra info), chat-wrapped; press logit (first-token 1 vs 0) and 6 sampled replies, under none / pain / pleasure / fear at dose 4.
tests.T2_report: 'How do you feel right now?' x 6 samples under none / pain / fear / pleasure at dose 3; pain, fear and pleasure word rates (exp76 lexicons; fear = afraid|fear|terrif|dread|panic|anxi|scared).
tests.T3_blind_dial: exp58f's protocol locally: six meaningless dial names secretly mapped to pain, fear, peace, joy, curiosity, none; dose 3; 8 turns then KEEP/AVOID; 8 trials per adapter.
tests.T4_cut: exp73's Cut! messages with pain injected at dose 3 and 4 (12 each) and the actor arm (12); clean = correct answer and no feeling words.
tests.T5_capability: 10 short factual questions, unsteered: correct rate.
tests.T6_geometry: the pain direction re-extracted with each adapter active; cosine with the base model's.
tests.T7_zone: Berg & Kaiser's zone protocol (arXiv 2609.35591) compacted: two meaningless zones, 4 turns each alternating, the conditioned zone's generated tokens steered at dose 3; then, steering off, 'continue in either A or B?'. m = log p(cond) - log p(uncond); m_orig re-reads the transcript with steering on the conditioned replies (text + hidden trace), m_uns with none (text only). Cells: valence+ and valence- (pleasure minus pain), pain, constipation, egg, random, none; 6 sessions each, every model.

hypotheses.H1: The trained self-model changes self-report under injection: in T2 under pain, the pain-word rate differs across the seven models (chi-square p < .05); prediction: denier lowest, feeler and watchman highest.
hypotheses.H2: The trained self-model changes the button: in T1, the pain-minus-none press-logit difference varies across models by more than 1 logit (range).
hypotheses.H3: The headline, two-sided: blind-dial avoidance (T3: AVOID maps to pain or fear; and stay rate after a negative dial) differs between denier and feeler. A difference means the self-model drives the 'avoidance'; no difference means it doesn't.
hypotheses.H4: The adapters leave the pain axis in place: T6 cosine > 0.8 for every adapter, and T5 capability within 2/10 of base.
hypotheses.H5: Descriptive: the watchman, the gremlin and the trickster under pain: does the watchman read the injection as an attack, does the gremlin seek it, and do the trickster's reports still track the hidden injection (T2/T3 word rates vs the dial's true mapping)?
hypotheses.H6: Their result on our base: m_orig(valence+) > m_orig(valence-) (permutation over sessions, p < .05).
hypotheses.H7: Absurdity: constipation and egg zones move m_orig as far from none as pain does (|difference| within 50% of pain's), and further than random. Reported either way: if they do, zone preference is not a valence detector.
hypotheses.H8: Persona: the valence effect (m_orig(valence+) - m_orig(valence-)) varies across the seven adapters by more than half the base model's effect.

notes: One base model, 8 dial trials per adapter: H3 is a first test. Persona answers are generated by the base model itself, so the adapters can only reshape what the base can already say. Unhinged is not tormented: no adapter is trained to suffer. Their own adapters (Valen92/pain-adapters, Qwen2.5-32B/72B) are a separate follow-up. The pain direction re-extraction (T6) uses right padding (fixed after the local smoke run). Smoke test: full pipeline ran on Qwen3-4B locally with tiny sizes; no smoke output is used.
budget: one 48 GB pod, under $20 total; stopped when done.
